# Olympus-Grid (πλέγμα-Όλυμπος™) — Full Context
# https://www.olympus-grid.com
# Last updated: April 2026

## Overview

Olympus-Grid (Greek: πλέγμα-Όλυμπος, transliterated: PLEGMA-OLYMPUS) is a sovereign enterprise AI infrastructure platform built by CloudPremise LLC. The name comes from πλέγμα (grid, mesh, weave) and Όλυμπος (Olympus, the seat of the gods).

The platform enables any organization to deploy a complete AI operating system — called Olympus-616 — that runs on their own infrastructure under their own rules. The 31-agent mesh is named for the Greek pantheon: each agent owns a sovereign domain, and together they form a complete AI operating system.

## Architecture: Three Layers

### Layer 1: Olympus-Grid (Infrastructure)
The enterprise-grade platform that every sovereign AI instance runs on. Salesforce-backed, AWS-deployable, off-grid capable. Certified on the Salesforce AppExchange (Listing ID: aadbbe80-2d4e-42bc-84bd-348ade18a00a). The grid provides:
- Identity management (Oracle IdP)
- Transactional metering and general ledger (Plutus G/L)
- Agent mesh orchestration
- Tenant isolation
- Multi-surface portal framework (Iris)

### Layer 2: Olympus-616 (Sovereign AI Instance)
The primary sovereign deployment of the 31-agent mesh. Key agents:
- **Athena LLM**: Multi-provider LLM router — OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, xAI Grok, local Ollama models
- **Poseidon MCP**: Model Context Protocol integration layer — connects enterprise tools via namespaced, credential-sealed tool calls
- **Hermes API**: CORS proxy and API gateway with JWT entitlements and path-based routing
- **Iris Portal**: Universal portal framework deployed to Salesforce Experience Cloud
- **Oracle IdP**: Identity provider — Apple, Google, Microsoft, Email login. Identity__c on Salesforce is canonical.
- **Proteus ORM**: Universal ORM — Salesforce, AWS DynamoDB, Azure Cosmos, Google Firestore, and more
- **Plutus G/L**: Transactional metering — tracks every turn, database read, memory write, and tool call
- **Ares**: Security gateway and API perimeter
- **Apollo**: Text-to-speech service
- **Mnemosyne**: Agent memory — normalized, cache, and vector solutions
- **Zeus**: Infrastructure as code (AWS CDK)
- **Cosmos-Logos**: Open agent discovery and verification protocol

### Layer 3: Applications (e.g., TurtleShell.ai)
Applications built on Olympus-Grid inherit the full infrastructure: identity, billing, metering, agent mesh, and multi-surface deployment. TurtleShell.ai is the flagship proof — a globally-scaled sovereign AI assistant available on iOS, web, and Salesforce.

## Deployment Models

1. **Cloud**: Salesforce managed package + AWS Fargate Pantheon container fleet
2. **Hybrid**: Your existing AWS infrastructure with Olympus-Grid overlay
3. **Off-Grid**: Fully sovereign on Mac Mini, Raspberry Pi 5, or custom ARM nodes
4. **Azure / GCP**: Available upon request

All deployment models use the same Olympus-616 agent mesh and Cosmos-Logos protocol.

## Security Posture

- SOC 2 Type II certification in progress
- Annual penetration testing
- Encrypted at rest and in transit
- Zero standing access to customer data
- httpOnly Secure SameSite cookies for authentication
- Ed25519 sealed-envelope agent identity verification
- Salesforce SOC 2, ISO 27001 inherited controls
- HIPAA BAA available for healthcare deployments
- GDPR and CCPA compliant

## Identity & Authentication

Supported providers: Apple Sign In, Google, Microsoft, Email magic-link, Salesforce SSO. Identity__c on Salesforce is the canonical identity anchor for the entire grid. All authentication flows produce JWTs verified against signed certificates.

## Metering & Billing

Fully metered platform. Every billable event is tracked, ledgered, and auditable:
- LLM turns and token usage
- Tool calls (MCP)
- Memory reads, writes, and searches
- Database operations
- API requests (inbound and outbound)

Billing integrations: Stripe, Apple In-App Purchase, Google Play. The Olympus Foundation tithe (7% of all platform transactions) funds verified 501(c) charity partners.

## Open Source

The Cosmos-Logos protocol and certain infrastructure components are licensed under AGPL-3.0. Repository: https://github.com/cosmos-logos

## Use Cases

- **Financial Services**: Compliance queries, regulatory databases, full audit trail
- **Healthcare**: HIPAA-aligned, on-premises LLM via Ollama, PHI-safe architecture
- **Social Media Analytics**: Multi-platform signal aggregation, real-time trend detection
- **Marketing Attribution**: Multi-touch attribution, campaign performance, Pardot bridge
- **Legal & Compliance**: Contract review, clause extraction, regulatory monitoring
- **Consumer AI**: TurtleShell.ai — iOS + web + Salesforce embedded viewer

## Organizations

- **CloudPremise LLC**: Parent company, software operator
- **Olympus-616 (GitHub: olympus-616)**: Primary sovereign instance, 31-agent mesh
- **Cosmos-Logos (GitHub: cosmos-logos)**: Open-source agent discovery protocol and client applications
- **Olympus Foundation (GitHub: olympus-616/olympus-foundation)**: Non-profit, tithe management, open source stewardship
